sloka: आहूयन्तां प्रकृतयः पुरोधा मन्त्रिणस्तथा ।कार्यार्थिनश्च पुरुषाः स्त्रियश्च पुरुषर्षभ ।। ७.५३.५ ॥
transliteration: āhūyantāṁ prakṛtayaḥ purodhā mantriṇastathā ।kāryārthinaśca puruṣāḥ striyaśca puruṣarṣabha ।। 7.53.5 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, let the principal officers, the chief priest, the ministers, and also the men and women seeking justice be summoned.
translations.hindi: वह प्रियङ्गु, कदम्ब, बकुले, जामुन, अनार और कोवि- दार के वृक्षों से शोभित था
